detail.title: Predictive Processing and Musical Valence
detail.summary: Musical emotional valence can be modeled as the integration of motor-based auditory timing predictions (ASAP hypothesis) and interoceptive inference, where prediction errors serve as the substrate for affective response.
detail.reason: This notebook updates the previous provisional synthesis to incorporate specific, eligible evidence regarding the interplay between predictive timing and interoceptive emotional processing.
